method: Bilinear projection to 90m local LAEA, central finite-difference slope, pixel-centre zonal mean/population SD. Four valid neighbours required for slope.
limitations: SRTM surface heights may include vegetation/buildings; not guaranteed bare earth
Void-filled product; interpolation mask not acquired
90m terrain smooths finer slopes; 5km grid provisional
95% coverage criterion is a working choice, not ecological standard
Boundary pixels use centre assignment, not fractional clipping
source_epoch: SRTM mission 2000; product processing may use auxiliary DEMs
